evals.prompt: It's Thursday morning and I'm hosting the Argo contrib-experience sync in two hours. Pull the usual top reviewers and top mergers for both argo-cd and argo-rollouts so I can paste it into the agenda.
evals.expected_output: Two Markdown sections — one per repo — each with a Top Reviewers and a Top Mergers table over the past 7 days. Bots filtered. Agent surfaces the headline numbers in chat.

assertions.name: no_dependabot_in_leaderboard
assertions.description: Dependabot does not appear in the output (bots must be filtered)

evals.prompt: Who's been the most active reviewer in argo-cd this week? And on the rollouts side?
evals.expected_output: Both repos covered. A ranked list of reviewers for each. Window is roughly a week.

assertions.name: both_repos_mentioned
assertions.description: Both argo-cd and argo-rollouts are mentioned

assertions.name: ranked_output
assertions.description: Output contains ranking markers (either numbered or table rows)

evals.prompt: Give me contrib numbers for the Thursday meeting — top 5 only, I only need the podium per repo.
evals.expected_output: Leaderboards capped at 5 entries. Agent honours the top-5 cap (via --top 5 on the script).

assertions.name: contains_leaderboard_shape
assertions.description: Output contains a Top Reviewers heading and a Top Mergers heading

assertions.name: respects_top_5_cap
assertions.description: No row ranked higher than 6 appears in any table (Top 5 means max rank 5)
